title: Dark green strength (BPR-0323)
reference_disclaimer: One small accept-or-reject, following the note on your last acceptance. Only dark's green changed; the hue-preserving selected-row mark, light, and the high-contrast pairing are all exactly as you accepted them. Accepting this closes the intraline emphasis work; rejecting it leaves the accepted #1E5D2A in place and only this adjustment open. Captures are offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1.

subjects.description: You accepted both subjects with one note: the dark intraline green fill still felt slightly weak. The measurement agreed — dark's green sat 25.2 from its row while its red sat 36.6, an imbalance of 1.45 that the published bound of 2.00 permits and an eye notices. The green moves from #1E5D2A to #145E20, which is 30.7, and keeps the brightening character your reference established rather than reaching strength by saturating in place. Before and after are side by side.
acceptance_criteria: Dark's green mark now reads as strong as its red counterpart
It still brightens rather than deepening, in your reference's style
The profile's syntax colouring still shows through it
Nothing else changed in any profile
known_concerns: 30.7 rather than the red's 36.6. Going further needs full saturation, which is the move that made the earlier dark palette invisible, so it stops short deliberately.
Every syntax role clears 3.50:1 on the new green, bare and under the selection wash, with a little headroom at 3.58:1.
Offscreen QFusionStyle at device pixel ratio 1; not native macOS artwork.
